A former nuclear-plant controls engineer proposes deliberate manual gates in AI-assisted engineering, drawing on the automation paradox and AF 447, and the thread disputes whether lost skills come back.
Ed West on James Marriott's case that television and then smartphones undid mass literacy and reasoned public debate, with the studies behind it.
A free, openly licensed English translation of Conchon and Filliâtre's OCaml textbook, and a thread arguing whether an ML language, C or Python should come first.
A tiny interactive comedy in which an agent cannot simply make a button blue, and a 450-comment thread of first-hand reports on agents over-engineering trivial changes and how people rein them in.

A report on LG TVs recording audio with the screen off, and a thousand-comment thread on whether click-through terms can consent for guests and bystanders under EU and US law.
